posts.cooked:
@hemalatha
I hope you are doing well. I wanted to seek your guidance regarding the System Commands course. There are a lot of resources and videos available on the portal and Discourse, and instead of making progress, I sometimes feel stuck and overwhelmed about where to begin and how to proceed systematically.

For now, I am watching the lectures on the portal and attending the live sessions to grasp the concepts. However, I still tend to forget many of the commands after some time, which makes me worried, especially when I hear from peers that the OPPE is quite challenging.

Could you please suggest an effective approach to prepare for this course? Specifically:

  • How should I balance between watching lectures and practicing commands?

  • Are there particular exercises or resources you would recommend focusing on for the OPPE?

  • Any tips on retaining the commands better?

I really want to prepare well and score a good grade, and your guidance would mean a lot.

Thank you so much for your time and support.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Hi @23f2000539

Don’t worry. You don’t need to feel overwhelmed. This is what I did -
Let’s say you want to do Week 2

  • Watch a single course lecture first
  • Practice commands that you see in that. You don’t need to make list of the commands as they are available in slides.
  • Try to make handy notes (small & simple ones) it can be in online mode. You can also make flash cards. These flash cards quiz you & the ones you do wrong will appear more often.
  • Move to the next lecture & practice
  • Keep one day where you can revise what you did in a week.

Each week has roughly 3-4 lectures with 30-40 minutes duration.

Time taken -

  • 30 - 40 mins in lectures
  • 20 - 25 mins practicing
  • 10 -15 mins notes (you can copy paste from your terminal)

1 hr 20 mins/day for 3-4 days and revision maybe 1 - 2 hours as you want once a week or as you feel comfortable.
Also, some lectures cover theory part.

Additionally, if you feel stuck you can ask doubts in Live/TA sessions or ask doubts here.

Join Live/TA sessions as they explain things in details. Also, you can refer to the book (great resource) as you want.

For starts, I would suggest you practice the questions on portal. Don’t worry about OPPE. After week 5, start solving questions in VM, hackerrank has bash questions & previous term.

I hope this plan helps.

Thanks & Regards,
Swati Jain

posts.cooked: Follow all live sessions and professor videos. And also practice all the practice questions provided in VM. And refer old question papers. Which will be available in ACEGRADE. Answer all BPTs and programming practice and graded assignment questions. I think u can perform better and will get good score.
